name: CSAR Script
summary: Simplified combat search and rescue script: ejected pilots must be picked up and returned to a MASH, airfield or FARP.
description:
Loaded inside a mission with a DO SCRIPT trigger after MIST. By default a crashed aircraft's slot stays disabled until its ejected pilot is rescued. Optional slot blocking needs csarSlotBlockGameGUI.lua placed in the DCS Scripts folder.

Requires: Requires MIST 4.0.57 or above; beacon.ogg needed for ADF homing.
